answer: One enforceable rule: lock a compute bond for six epochs and slash it the moment two answers fingerprint-match. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The onyx of work and the tide of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a juniper to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
